why: A clear later in a loop's body than a read reaches the read on the next pass, and MATLAB calls the function there (MATLAB R2026a, measured for step 16: in a script, `xa = 1; for k = 1:2, xa(1); eval('clear xa'); end` calls `xa` on the second pass, R7; a plain clear the same, MATLAB doc 'clear'; in a function, a name code `eval` runs made, cleared by a later text, the same, t5; a `while` condition read again after a clear in the body calls, P4; a text that reads and then clears the name calls on the second pass, M6). The extractor does not follow a clear round a loop (project ruling, step 16 round 4: the rule cost whole files and made wrong edges for a shape no corpus holds), so these reads stay the variable, as on base: the pending bug S18-clear-around-loop (`zklp1`, `zklp2`, `zklp5`, `zklp9`, `zklp11`, `zklp12`, `zklp19`). The shapes where MATLAB calls nothing pass and guard any later rule: a write after the clear (`zklp3.m`, `zklp6.m`), a clear on one branch (`zklp4.m`, project rule), a `for` loop's own variable, written again on every pass (`zklp7.m`: MATLAB doc 'for', and measured for step 16, P2), a clear a `break` follows (`zklp8.m`, P3), an `if` every branch of which leaves (`zklp13.m`: MATLAB doc 'break', 'return'), a write on a branch after the clear (`zklp10.m`, project rule), a text that clears and writes the name again (`zklp14.m`, `zklp15.m`: measured for step 16, M1, M2), and a clear followed by `error` (`zklp16.m`, M3), by `try, error(…); catch, break; end` (`zklp17.m`, M4) or by `try, break; catch, end` (`zklp18.m`, M5): no call. A clear moved before the read is a call on every pass (text order), and moved after the loop ends nothing the loop reads: each step must end where a fresh index ends (project rule).
